tokens.navDimensions: Nav is a HORIZONTAL TOP BAR, not a sidebar. Full width, 56px tall (embedded with hint-size="100%,56px"). Bar padding: calc(11px + env(safe-area-inset-top)) max(20px,env(safe-area-inset-right)) 11px max(20px,env(safe-area-inset-left)); z-index:40. Wide/narrow breakpoint: window.innerWidth > 860 (wide shows inline tabs; narrow shows hamburger + 300px slide-in drawer, max-width 86vw)
tokens.contentBackground: #f7f8fa (screen body, e.g. Home.dc.html); content column max-width:1240px, margin:0 auto, padding:24px 28px 64px

fontFamilies.mono: 'IBM Plex Mono',monospace — Google Fonts, weights 400;500 loaded (badges rendered at 700)

groupDropdown.panel: position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 6px);left:0;min-width:214px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e8eaee;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 14px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.22);z-index:70;color:#16181d;padding:6px (backdrop: fixed inset-0 z-65 transparent click-catcher)

badges.topLevelBadge: same but padding:1px 6px — DEFINED IN MARKUP BUT NEVER SHOWN: showBadge is hardcoded false for all top-level items (links and groups) in wide mode; badges only render on dropdown children, drawer items, and the bell

companyRow.markTile: 30x30px, border-radius:7px, background:{accent}, color:#fff, font-weight:700, font-size:12px; letter = companyName.trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase() || 'P'
companyRow.betaChip: 'BETA' — IBM Plex Mono 9.5px, weight 600, letter-spacing:.08em, color:{accent}, border:1px solid #3a3e46, background:#23262d, padding:2px 6px, border-radius:5px

search.kbdChip: '⌘K' IBM Plex Mono 11px color #5b606a border 1px solid #3a3e46 radius 4px padding 1px 5px
search.magnifierIcon: pure CSS: 13px circle, border:1.6px solid #6b7079, handle 6x1.6px rotated 45deg
search.resultsPanel: top:44px;right:0;width:344px;max-width:88vw;max-height:60vh;bg #fff;border 1px #e8eaee;radius 12px;shadow 0 16px 46px rgba(0,0,0,.24);padding:6px; group labels 9.5px/600/ls .07em/uppercase/#aab0bb; result icon 24x24 radius 7px mono 10px 700 white-on-color; title 13px 600; sub 11px #9aa0ab mono; searches QuoteStore/SandboxStore/SurveyStore/InspectionStore/CommStore/customers-from-quotes/MASTER_CATALOG parts; Cmd/Ctrl+K focuses

syncChip.dot: 9px circle; syncing:#3d8bf2 + animation nav-pulse 1s ease-in-out infinite (opacity 1→.35→1); offline or pending:#d98a2b; synced:#3fae74

tokens.bellButton: 34x34px, border-radius:9px, background:#23262d, border:1px solid #2f323a, color:#cfd3da; 17x17 inline SVG bell, stroke:currentColor, stroke-width:2
tokens.accountButton: 34x34px circle, background:{accent}, color:#fff, initials font-size:12px weight 600
tokens.adminChip: 'ADMIN' — IBM Plex Mono 9px weight 600 ls .06em, color:#8a6d1f, background:#fbf3dd, border:1px solid #f0e2bd, padding:1px 6px, radius 5px
tokens.accentApplication: accent = window.AppSettings.get().accent (settings.js, localStorage-backed) falling back to prop default '#7b3f8a'. Applied to: company mark tile bg, BETA chip text, all count badges bg, bell badge bg, notif '{N} open' chip (text color + bg color-mix(in srgb, {accent} 13%, #fff)), account avatar bg, drawer avatar bg, roster current-user checkmark, drawer active-item 6px dot, 'Sync now' button bg (when enabled), 'Q' quote icons in search/notifs. Nav re-renders on window events 'rss-settings','rss-notifprefs','rss-sync','rss-survey','rss-lead' + resize
tokens.otherColors: hamburger bars #e7e9ee on #23262d/#2f323a button 42x42 radius 10px; drawer bg #16181d, borders #23262d, sync block bg #1d2026 border #2b2e35 radius 13px; menu dividers #f0f1f4; muted text #9aa0ab; section labels #aab0bb (light panels) / #6b7079 (drawer); secondary text #cfd3da; sign-out #8c919c; list chevron '›' #c4c9d2; scrims rgba(16,18,22,.5)/.55

navGroups.label: Home
navGroups.icon: none — nav items are text-only (groups add '▾' chevron)

navGroups.label: Inbox
navGroups.badge: commWaiting = CommStore.unreadCount() if present, else count of CommStore threads with status==='waiting_us' — NOTE: computed but never displayed at top level (showBadge:false in wide nav); shows only in narrow drawer

navGroups.label: Sales

children.label: Leads

children.label: Reviews

navGroups.groupBadge: badgeSum of children computed but showBadge:false — group header never shows a badge

shell.layout: Dark top bar (NOT a sidebar): single 56px-tall row, background #16181d, z-index:40, flex row space-between. LEFT cluster (gap 16px): [narrow-only hamburger 42x42] + company-mark tile 30x30 + company name + BETA chip, then (wide only, gap 3px) inline nav tabs Home / Inbox / Sales▾ / Installs▾ / Service▾ / General▾. RIGHT cluster (gap 10px): sync status chip (order default), search field (order:2), bell/to-do (order:3), account avatar (order:4); on narrow, search field+avatar are replaced by a 42x42 search button (order:2) that opens a full-width top search sheet
shell.padding: bar: calc(11px + env(safe-area-inset-top)) top, 11px bottom, max(20px, env(safe-area-inset-left/right)) horizontal
shell.embedding: Every screen embeds it as <dc-import name="Nav" active="<key>" hint-size="100%,56px" style="flex-shrink:0;position:relative;z-index:30;"></dc-import> inside a height:100vh flex-column wrapper; the page body below is flex:1;overflow-y:auto (nav itself never scrolls, it is sticky by layout). support.js walks <dc-import> tags, loads Nav.dc.html's <x-dc> template + Component class, and passes attributes as props
shell.activeProp: active prop enum: home,inbox,sales,leads,quotes,design,reviews,installs,projects,schedule,fieldwork,service,flametests,inspections,repairs,general,customers,field,catalog,reports,rules,import,settings,''. Active child key maps to its parent group (activeParent) so the group tab gets the active style (#2b2e35 bg, #fff, 600) when any child screen is open; dropdown marks the exact child with #f4f5f7 bg + weight 600
shell.dropdownBehavior: one group open at a time (state.openGroup); transparent fixed overlay (z-65) closes on outside click; Escape closes; opening notif/menu closes others
shell.narrowDrawer: left slide-in drawer 300px (max 86vw), bg #16181d, shadow 18px 0 50px rgba(0,0,0,.5), scrim rgba(16,18,22,.55), animations nav-scrim .18s / nav-drawer .22s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1). Contains: account header (42px accent avatar, name 15px/600, role 11.5px #9aa0ab, 36x36 close button), sync status block (bg #1d2026, border 1px #2b2e35, radius 13px, headline 13px/600, detail 11.5px #9aa0ab, 'Sync now' button flex:1 13px/600 white on {accent} — disabled state bg #2b2e35 opacity .6 — and 'Work offline'/'Go online' outline button border 1px #2f323a color #cfd3da), scrollable nav list (links 15px, section headers 10px/600/uppercase/#6b7079, child links 14.5px padded-left 18px; active: #fff on #23262d weight 600 + 6px accent dot; inactive #cfd3da weight 500; badges shown when >0), appended 'Account settings' and 'Settings' links, footer 'Sign out' (#8c919c) above safe-area padding
shell.syncIndicator: online/offline indicator = sync chip (always visible, all widths). Reads window.SyncEngine.status() -> {online, paused, connected, pending, syncing, lastSyncAt}. States: syncing (dot #3d8bf2 pulsing, 'Syncing…'), not connected (dot #d98a2b, 'Offline · N' or 'Offline'; headline 'Working offline' if paused else 'No connection'), pending>0 (dot #d98a2b, 'N pending'), else (dot #3fae74, 'Synced', detail 'Everything on this device is in the office. Last sync {timeAgo}.'). Chip click: if disconnected → open drawer (to reach sync block), else SyncEngine.syncNow(). Drawer also has a Work offline/Go online toggle via SyncEngine.setPaused()

accountMenu.trigger: 34x34 circle button, background {accent}, white initials 12px/600. Initials = Team.initials(me); current user me = window.Team.CURRENT || 'Jeff Chesebro'
accountMenu.panel: position:absolute;top:42px;right:0;width:238px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e8eaee;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 14px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.22);z-index:70;color:#16181d; fixed transparent backdrop z-65 closes it

accountMenu.switchUser: section label 'SWITCH USER' 10px/600/ls .06em/uppercase/#aab0bb; scrollable max-height:172px; rows from Team.roster(): 26px avatar in per-user color (u.color), name 13px/500 #3a3f4a, accent '✓' 13px/700 on current user; hover #f7f8fa; click = Team.setCurrent(name) + location.reload()
links: 'General settings' -> Settings.dc.html, right-aligned ADMIN chip (IBM Plex Mono 9px/600 ls .06em, #8a6d1f on #fbf3dd, border 1px #f0e2bd, padding 1px 6px, radius 5px)
accountMenu.footer: border-top 1px #f0f1f4: 'Send feedback' button (13px #3a3f4a) opens mailto:{AppSettings.feedbackEmail()}?subject='Peak beta feedback' with body containing From/Page/Time; 'Sign out' button (13px #8c919c) — prototype only closes the menu
accountMenu.narrowEquivalent: on narrow screens the avatar/menu is absent from the bar; drawer header shows 42px avatar + name 15px/600 + role, and drawer list carries the Account settings / Settings / Sign out entries

todoCenter.trigger: bell button (34x34, radius 9, #23262d bg, 1px #2f323a border, #cfd3da icon, 17x17 stroke-2 SVG bell), positioned right of search (order:3), always visible at all widths. Count badge only when count>0: -5px/-5px offset, min-width 17px, h 17px, radius 9px, {accent} bg, white IBM Plex Mono 10px/700, 2px #16181d border
todoCenter.panel: top:44px;right:0;width:360px;max-width:92vw;max-height:70vh;overflow-y:auto;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e8eaee;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 16px 46px rgba(0,0,0,.24);z-index:70. Sticky header: 'To-do' 14px/600 + count chip '{N} open' (IBM Plex Mono 10.5px/600, color {accent}, bg color-mix(in srgb,{accent} 13%,#fff), padding 2px 8px, radius 20px), padding 13px 15px 11px, border-bottom 1px #f0f1f4
todoCenter.itemLayout: group label 9.5px/600/ls .07em/uppercase/#aab0bb (padding 10px 10px 4px); item = <a> flex gap 11px padding 10px radius 8px hover #f4f5f7: 26x26 radius-7 letter tile (IBM Plex Mono 10px/700 white on category color) + title 13px/600 ellipsis + sub 11px #9aa0ab + '›' 15px #c4c9d2
todoCenter.emptyState: 'You’re all caught up' 13px/600 #3a3f4a + 'Reviews, survey requests and at-risk projects assigned to you show up here.' 12px #9aa0ab, padding 34px 18px centered

categories.label: Customers waiting on a reply

categories.label: Projects need attention
categories.source: ProjectStore: stage!=='complete' && riskFlags(p).length; sub = first risk flag

categories.label: Repairs awaiting scheduling
categories.source: RepairStore: stage==='approved'; sub includes priorityMeta label + 'awaiting scheduling'

categories.label: Leads needing follow-up
categories.source: LeadStore.followUps({unownedOrMine:true, me}); sub = followUpInfo label + source short (+ ' · unassigned' when no owner)

todoCenter.badgeMath: groups are filtered by per-user prefs: NotifPrefs.get(me) hides any group whose key has prefs[key]===false; count = sum of items across VISIBLE groups; bell badge and '{N} open' chip render only when count>0, panel shows empty state when count===0. NOTE: the bell count is independent of the nav item badges — it re-derives from the stores directly (same underlying filters, different code paths)

Data stores loaded by the Nav helmet: settings.js, team.js, notifprefs.js, store.js (QuoteStore), sandbox.js (SandboxStore), sync.js (SyncEngine), survey.js (SurveyStore), project.js (ProjectStore), inspect.js (InspectionStore), comm.js (CommStore), flamejobs.js (FlameJobStore), repair.js/repairjobs.js (RepairStore), lead.js (LeadStore), catalog-data.js (MASTER_CATALOG). Gotchas for a pixel-faithful rebuild: (1) this is a top bar, height 56px — there is no left sidebar in wide mode; (2) top-level tabs NEVER show badges (showBadge hardcoded false) even though badge markup exists — badges appear only in group dropdowns, the narrow drawer, and the bell; (3) 'Sign out' is a no-op (closes menu); (4) the '{N} open' chip uses CSS color-mix(in srgb, accent 13%, #fff); (5) Cmd/Ctrl+K focuses search (wide) or opens the search sheet (narrow), Escape closes all popovers; (6) Nav listens to window events rss-settings, rss-notifprefs, rss-sync, rss-survey, rss-lead to re-render; (7) the Home.png screenshot shows the sync chip overlapping tabs at 924px width because it renders in wide mode near the breakpoint — real breakpoint for narrow is <=860px; (8) hrefs contain spaces/percent-encoding exactly as listed (e.g. 'Field Work.dc.html', 'Flame%20Tests.dc.html' in notif links but 'Flame Tests.dc.html' in nav config).
